correctness.rationale: For primitive period two the total firing count per vertex over two updates is harmonic and hence one on a connected graph. The local chip intervals have exactly b_v possibilities each, and their converse constructs all primitive two-cycle states, giving half the weighted phase-cut sum. The six-class rung transfer is reconstructed entrywise, and exact rational-matrix arithmetic plus the Cayley–Hamilton identity yields the all-n generating function. The root expansion gives the precise asymptotic. The included executable independently checks transfer class construction, six polynomial residual seeds, 87,376 phase words, and 341,248 bounded chip states. These finite checks corroborate, rather than replace, the infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The evaluated claim is the exact six-state ladder transfer, rational orbit generating function and root-controlled growth, not the generic cut-phase criterion or transfer-matrix technique. The relevant primary full texts were compared at claim and implication level. Dall'Asta enumerates ring-model sandpile phases, Jiang concerns possible periods (and K_{a,b}), Fey–Levine–Wilson evaluate a ladder stationary-density observable for a distinct sandpile setup, and Jiang–Scully–Zhang characterize general firing patterns. No inspected statement specifies or implies the open-ladder primitive-two-cycle orbit census. Actual published-finding corpus semantic queries found no equivalent or stronger ladder enumeration. This is a bounded originality assessment, not a proof of uniqueness.
residual_risks: The general phase-cut identity may have other prior presentations and is not asserted as new.
An unindexed ladder enumeration or implicit published spectral transfer identity might subsume this rational count; no exhaustive literature index exists.

The historical general article Parallel Chip-Firing Games on Graphs (Bitar and Goles, 1992) was identified bibliographically but its full text was not inspected in this review; the inaccessible source does not itself establish coverage.

value.rationale: Open ladders are a canonical width-two cyclic strip, making the exact primitive period-two orbit census a natural dynamical invariant between tree cases and planar lattices. This theorem gives one exact formula for every rung length, a six-state structural reduction, a fourth-order scalar recurrence and the sharp exponential rate 6+sqrt(35). The result is not an arbitrary finite tabulation, small incremental adjustment or renaming of previously enumerated graph families. It may inform wider-strip recurrent orbit enumeration; no unsupported downstream theorem is claimed.
